checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja, Ghidra, and Radare2 identify the same leaf body by VA. Binary Ninja catalog names differ from semantic GameNatives aliases; alias identity remains provisional.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: cdecl 32-bit stack arguments are read from [ESP+4] and, for the pointer accessor, [ESP+8].

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The body uses index*0x44; retail field offset is 0x8C.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Pointer chain and MESH offsets match the 32-bit record declarations and static assertions.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Both accessors are leaf bodies with no calls or writes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Pointer address or sign-extended 16-bit count returns in EAX; no branches or error paths.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Integer pointer and count operations only.

limitations: Semantic GameNatives aliases remain provisional because Binary Ninja retains different catalog symbol names.
Candidate and retail machine bodies were emulated under Radare2 ESIL; no live game or IGI-Probe trace was available.
